payload.text: **A verdict count excludes classes, and an absence bound greens under load** (2026-09-20, cc, ic, dc; vc's 0481 clause at 608a17333 and 8bf8ccb9f): `doctor: 0 finding(s)` prints with a store-stale advisory directly above it, so a count is not an output and the line that would have said so is read whole, the same rule as `ac gate`'s exit. Load reds a presence-asserting arm and never false-greens it (the same intentsvcs suite green at load 592 and at 21), and inverts for an assertion that nothing happened within a window; every absence bound in intentd's watcher suite is a duration, settle included, so a green on those arms counts only at the floor, about 10 on this host.
